purpose: The text we serve says what the page says, and we tell readers how good it is.
outside_check: Pair with the containment debt (about 1,740 live books under a text-trust hold, 2026-10-11) so withholding cannot pass as repair; re-run the Clef image-text screen on a fresh random draw (#5803: 36 of 1,497 books flagged); Gemini second reader on the same pages (#6338)

queue.title: Make the NO-GO pause real: land PR #6422 so the translate gate's flag is read
queue.why: The 2026-10-10 gate found text not on the leaf on 4 of 30 pages and paused nothing; new invented English is still being written
queue.measure: pages with text not on the leaf in the gate sample (4/30)

queue.title: Run the two decided Tibetan steps from the main box: translate 26,440 readable held pages, apply 738 Yigdzin reads after a by-eye check of 3

queue.title: Keep the convergent review running on top-read books and act on its 8 fix verdicts

queue.title: Build the Clef-witnessed override and re-archive the four e-rara books (Troumbüchlin, Pymander, De re metallica, Agrippa)
